title: Bottlenecked semantic compression by representation reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.17412v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision Transformers incur high computational costs when processing long visual token sequences. Existing reduction methods typically rank tokens independently and discard those deemed unimportant or redundant. We propose a reconstruction-guided framework for visual token condensation (ReConV), which summarizes the complete visual sequence with a compact Summary Bank (SMB) and retains tokens whose information is not adequately captured by the SMB, as indicated by their reconstruction residuals. At each compression layer, a lightweight position-conditioned decoder reconstructs the current tokens, leaving shared information compressed in the SMB while explicitly preserving poorly reconstructed details. Experiments on image classification and multimodal understanding demonstrate favorable performance-efficiency trade-offs: ReConV surpasses the uncompressed baseline with 48\% fewer GMACs on ImageNet and enables reusable image-level represen

translated_title: 基于表示重建的瓶颈式语义压缩
translated_abstract: 视觉Transformer在处理长视觉token序列时会产生高昂的计算成本。现有的token削减方法通常独立地对token进行排序，并丢弃那些被认为不重要或冗余的token。我们提出了一种重建引导的视觉token压缩框架（ReConV），该框架使用一个紧凑的摘要库来总结完整的视觉序列，并保留那些其信息未被摘要库充分捕获的token，这一情况通过它们的重建残差来指示。在每个压缩层，一个轻量级的位置条件解码器对当前token进行重建，将共享信息压缩存储在摘要库中，同时显式保留重建效果较差的细节。在图像分类和多模态理解任务上的实验展示了良好的性能与效率权衡：ReConV在ImageNet上以减少48%的GMACs计算量超越了未压缩的基线，并实现了可复用的图像级表示。
tldr: 该论文提出了ReConV框架，利用摘要库和重建残差引导视觉token压缩，在ImageNet上以减少48%计算量的同时超越了未压缩基线的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ReConV, a reconstruction-guided framework that condenses visual tokens using a compact Summary Bank and reconstruction residuals, surpassing the uncompressed baseline on ImageNet with 48% fewer GMACs.
